description: Command line tool that checks e-invoices (CII and UBL XML, Factur-X and ZUGFeRD PDF) offline against the official rule files: the European standard EN 16931, then each country's own rules, starting with the French reform's BR-FR. It explains each failing rule with the invoice's own values.
rules: Install the official rule packs once with `lintvoice rules install`; checks then run offline.
Use `--format json` to read results in code: each file lists its failing rules, and a failing totals or VAT rule carries its computation.
Use `--rule <ID>` to ask about one rule: the answer is fails, warns, no-error, does-not-apply (with the reason) or not-checked.
Exit code 4 means a rule set could not run on a file: the check is incomplete and must not be reported as passing.
No errors means the invoice passes the rules lintvoice ran, not that a platform will accept it.
Each explained rule has a page at https://lintvoice.com/rules/<ID>/ saying what it checks and how to fix it.
